about: A daily all-day series, one day deleted and the delete undone (so the day has no row and no skip), the series made timed at 16:00 Los Angeles (00:00 UTC the next day) for all events, then the redo of the delete: refused as not_undoable with nothing written here or sent, since nothing recorded where that day went (x-undo-fields: a refused undo writes nothing). Before the gate it was placed: first on the equal key, which west of UTC is the day before, then by its date.
